overview: Manhattanite Ashley is known to many as the luckiest woman around. After a chance encounter with a down-and-out young man, however, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.
tagline: Everything changed in the wink of an eye.

recs.blurb: A woman risks losing her chance of happiness with the only man she has ever loved.
A chance encounter with a stranger changes the life of a college gymnast.
A lighthearted story about a man and a woman who seem destined to be together... and the hilarious chain of accidents that seem determined to keep them apart!
A young man finds solace with a young woman, his mother, and a high-school football coach who recruits him to quarterback a six-man team.
With John's social life at a standstill and his ex-wife about to get remarried, a down on his luck divorcée finally meets the woman of his dreams, only to…
Believing himself to be a jinx and bringing bad luck upon himself and others, a man attempts to find true love, but ends up in very complicated relationships.
After a breakup with her boyfriend, a young woman moves in with her older brother, his wife, and their 2-year-old son.
A young man is rocked by two announcements from his elderly father: that he has terminal cancer, and that he has a young male lover.
A man crippled by the mundanity of his life experiences something out of the ordinary.
As he copes with the death of his fiancee along with her parents, a young man must figure out what he wants out of life.
London is a drug laden adventure that centers on a party in a New York loft where a young man is trying to win back his ex-girlfriend.
A shallow man falls in love with a 300 pound woman because of her "inner beauty".
